title: Count of accepted blocks
statement: For natural numbers $q$ and $K$, a Boolean-valued function $B$ on Boolean lists, and a Boolean list $l$, define the block count as the number of integers $i$ with $0 \le i < K$ such that $B$ evaluates to true on the list obtained by dropping the first $iq$ entries of $l$ and then taking the next $q$ entries.
hypotheses_covered: A Boolean-valued function on Boolean lists
